source: RI-JRN01 O10 (creation terminates with a carried object); RI-CHR01 §1

items.name: Reed-case writ, stamped
template: PROVINCIAL OFFICE OF ARGONIA — WRIT OF PERSON
Issued at the Writ House, Tidewrack, by the hand of Warden-Scribe Tuleeh-Ma.
This case is stamped. It is the only thing in this province that says the bearer is a person rather than a shape somebody saw.

fields.%HatchNameOrNone: the hatch-name as given, or 'The bearer declined to give a second name.' if refused — and the refusal is itself a fact the world reads
fields.%ClaimLine: present only for The Unlit Water (and for Two-Drink taken with it): 'A claim is recorded against this bearer. The Office does not hold the claim and cannot discharge it.'
fields.%CasteLine: the caste topic keyed on class family — progression/classes.json#caste_topics
fields.%BountyRef: the crime ledger reference used by RI-CRM01 §4

items.referenced_by_npcs_note: RI-CHR01 §1 requires >= 6 NPCs to reference the writ by name later in the game. Three exist in this piece's scene; the other three are owned by W1-04/W1-11, and this field is the contract they inherit rather than a claim that they are built.

items.name: Reed-case writ, stamped and amended
items.template_note: Identical to stamped-writ except the name line, which reads: 'Name recorded: %OldPCName %PCName' with the old name struck through and legible. The Office does not pretend things did not happen.
